SHANGHAI, le 25 mai 2026 – Alors que l'i: SHANGHAI, May 25, 2026 – As the global semiconductor industry hits the physical limits of Moore's Law, tech giant Huawei made waves at IEEE ISCAS 2026 by proposing a new paradigm: the Tau ($\tau$) Scaling Law. This approach promises to revolutionize chip design by prioritizing temporal efficiency over geometric reduction.
Une alternative à la Loi de MooreHe Ting: An alternative to Moore's Law. He Tingbo, president of Huawei's semiconductor division (HiSilicon), explained during her keynote address that traditional transistor miniaturization is becoming less and less economically and technically viable. The "Tau Law" proposes shifting the focus: rather than trying to reduce component size at all costs, Huawei is now focusing on the systematic reduction of signal propagation delay (denoted as $\tau$) across circuits.
LogicFolding : L'innovation au cœur du s: LogicFolding: Innovation at the Heart of Silicon The spearhead of this strategy is the LogicFolding architecture. By rethinking the spatial arrangement of circuits and using advanced stacking techniques, Huawei claims a 55% increase in transistor density and a 41% gain in energy efficiency. This technology would enable the Chinese firm to bypass restrictions on access to the most sophisticated extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment.[1] Huawei thus plans to achieve performance equivalent to a 1.4 nm process by 2031, competing with global leaders like TSMC and Samsung on a purely architectural terrain.
Un déploiement imminent dans les puces K: An Imminent Deployment in Kirin Chips The validity of this approach is not merely theoretical. Huawei has revealed that it has already produced 381 chip models based on this methodological framework over the past six years. However, the real public test will take place in the fall of 2026 with the launch of the new Kirin processor series. These will be the first consumer products to fully integrate the LogicFolding architecture, promising a major performance leap for the brand's smartphones and artificial intelligence infrastructure. Towards Global Collaboration Despite geopolitical tensions, He Tingbo concluded her speech by insisting on the importance of international cooperation. "No single company can find all the answers on the path of semiconductor evolution," she stated, inviting researchers and engineers worldwide to explore this new path of temporal scaling. If the promises of Tau's Law materialize, Huawei could not only regain its technological independence, but also redefine industry performance standards for the next decade.
